question: Forecasting: does the model beat seasonal naive?
evidence: Δ level-12 WRMSSE -0.3017 (95% CI -0.3120 to -0.2927), 5/5 folds won (all 30,490 series)

question: ML: does LightGBM improve over statistical baselines?
evidence: vs stat_class_selected (full): Δ level-12 WRMSSE -0.0459 (95% CI -0.0496 to -0.0422), 5/5 folds won; vs ets (panel): Δ level-12 WRMSSE -0.0115 (95% CI -0.0275 to +0.0101), 3/5 folds won; vs arima (panel): Δ level-12 WRMSSE -0.0194 (95% CI -0.0349 to +0.0020), 4/5 folds won

question: Deep learning: do LSTM/TFT justify their complexity?
evidence: lstm vs LightGBM: Δ level-12 WRMSSE +0.0066 (95% CI -0.0116 to +0.0192), 2/5 folds won; tft vs LightGBM: Δ level-12 WRMSSE -0.0091 (95% CI -0.0332 to +0.0086), 4/5 folds won; seconds per fold: lgbm 63, lstm 142, tft 924

question: Uncertainty: are P10/P90 calibrated?
evidence: lgbm: P10 and P90 inside the discrete calibration bracket on 5/5 backtest folds

question: NLP: does the fine-tuned model beat simple baselines?
evidence: human-validated test labels not available yet; weak-label agreement is not test truth

question: Multimodal: do NLP-derived signals improve forecasting?
evidence: E_text_embeddings vs D_weather: Δ +0.0038 (CI +0.0009 to +0.0072), 0/5 folds; F_event_signals vs D_weather: Δ +0.0006 (CI -0.0021 to +0.0037), 2/5 folds

question: Inventory: does better forecasting reduce stockouts/excess cost in simulation?
evidence: P3 vs P1 at default: -45.9% cost (CI -77,730 to -39,567); lower in 4/4 stockout-cost scenarios

question: MLOps: can the system train, evaluate, register and deploy reproducibly?
evidence: 1 registry decisions with gate reports; champion seasonal_naive; DAGs import cleanly; `make evaluate` regenerates every artifact

question: Production: can it serve forecasts within acceptable latency?
evidence: /v1/forecast p95 9.4 ms (SLO 100), 749 req/s; /v1/inventory/recommend p95 15.6 ms (SLO 150), 382 req/s; /v1/events/extract p95 8.1 ms (SLO 300), 759 req/s; 4 cores

question: Monitoring: can we detect degraded data/model/system behaviour?
evidence: forecast checks alert, data drift ok, NLP alert; Prometheus alert rules and CloudWatch alarms cover latency, errors and availability
